title: Simulating gastrulation development and germ cell fate _in vitro_ using human and monkey pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Mix 500 ml of DMEM with 50 ml of FCS, 5 ml of L-Glutamine, and 5 ml of Penicillin-Streptomycin solution to prepare MEF medium.
Store the MEF medium at 4°C for up to one month.
Mix 37.6 ml of Essential 8 medium with 2 ml of KSR, 400 µl of Penicillin-Streptomycin solution, and 2.5 µM IWR1 to prepare modified cmPSC medium.
Store the modified cmPSC medium at 4°C for up to two weeks.
Mix 28.8 ml of Advanced RPMI 1640 medium with 300 µl of B27, 300 µl of NEAA, 300 µl of L-Glutamine, and 300 µl of Penicillin-Streptomycin solution to prepare aRB27.
Store the aRB27 at 4°C for up to one week.
Mix 10 ml of aRB27 with 100 ng/ml Activin A, 3 µM CHIR99021, and 10 µM Y-27632 to prepare ME medium.
For lateral mesoderm (LM) induction, add 100 ng/ml BMP2 to the ME medium.
Mix 10 ml of aRB27 with 500 ng/ml BMP2, 10 ng/ml hLIF, 100 ng/ml mSCF, 50 ng/ml mEGF, and 10 µM Y-27632 to prepare PGC medium.
Optionally add 2.5% PVA into the PGC medium to increase aggregation efficiency.
Gradually add 2 g of PVA to 20 ml of water with vigorous shaking, then leave it at 4°C for a few hours.
Warm the PVA solution in a 37°C water bath overnight to facilitate solubilization.
Sterilize the PVA stock by filtering through a 0.45 µm filter and store at cold room temperature for at least three months.
For each 10 ml of PGC medium, add 250 µl of 10% PVA stock.
Mix 10 ml of aRB27 with 100 ng/ml Activin A and 0.5 µM LDN193189 to prepare DE medium.
Culture hPSCs in Essential 8 medium on vitronectin-coated dishes according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Maintain routine cultures of hPSCs by passaging after every 3-5 days with dissociation using 0.5 mM EDTA.
Culture cmPSCs in modified cmPSC medium on MMC-treated or irradiated mouse embryonic fibroblast (MEF) at lower density, approximately 2x10^5 cells/well (6 well plate).
Routinely passage cmPSCs every 3-5 days with dissociation using 0.25% trypsin/EDTA.
Culture dissociated cmPSCs in modified cmPSC medium supplemented with 10 µM Y-27632.
Aspirate medium and wash PSCs with 1 ml of PBS.
Add 0.2-0.3 ml of 0.25% Trypsin/EDTA.
Incubate at 37°C for 3 min.
Add 1 ml of MEF medium while pipetting until cells are dissociated into single cells.
Centrifuge at 1,200 rpm for 4-5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and suspend cells in ME medium (0.2-1 ml).
Subject cells to pipetting a few times.
Count the number of cells.
Seed 2x10^5 cells/well (12 well plate) on vitronectin-coated plate.
Use at <sub>12 h (Pre-ME) for hPGC induction and at </sub>24-30 h (ME) for DE/LM induction.
Aspirate medium and wash Pre-ME cells with 0.5-1 ml of PBS.
Add 0.2-0.3 ml of 0.25% Trypsin/EDTA.
Incubate at 37°C for 3 min.
Add 1 ml of MEF medium and dissociate into single cells by repeated pipetting.
Centrifuge at 1,200 rpm for 4-5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and suspend cells in PGC medium (100 µl).
Pipette cells few times.
Count the number of cells.
Dilute the cell suspension with PGC medium to adjust the concentration of cells to 4x10e3 cells/100 µl/well.
Add 100 µl of the cell suspension into a single well of Corning® Costar® Ultra-Low attachment multiwell plates.
Centrifuge the plate at 1,200 rpm for 1-2 min to ‘aggregate’ the cells to the bottom of the wells.
Culture for 2-5 days.
Aspirate medium and wash cells (ME cells: normally 24-30h after ME induction) with 0.5-1 ml of PBS.
Add 1 ml of DE or LM medium.
Culture for 2-3 days (DE) or for 1-2 days (LM).
